audio.text: How about we split the cost of the textbook?

options: The textbook costs about eighty dollars.
I split my time between two jobs.
That works, since I only need it for one chapter.
The bookstore is across the street.

why.en: Suggestion → agreement with a reason. B reuses "split".
why.tr: Öneri → gerekçeli kabul. B "split" kelimesini tekrar ediyor.
